newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged amid dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged amid dull trading.

text.p: Pakistan cotton rates remained unchanged on Tuesday in lacklustre trading on lack of demand from mills and dealers said rates would soon slip on arrival of the 1997/98 (July-June) crop from next month.

"Only exporters are showing some interest, but there was not much activity today as mill owners remained on sidelines because of liquidity problems," dealer Nasim Usman said. "If there is no rain for another few days, new supplies will arrive in the market in June which will further depress prices."
In the kerb, NIAB-78 was traded at around 1,850 ($45.75) rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and K-68 at around 2,100.
